name: codegraph-worktree
description: Makes CodeGraph work in git worktrees: copies the index into a new worktree (copy-on-write where the file system can), indexes repositories that have none, and recommends installing CodeGraph when it is missing.

copyIntoWorktrees.title: Copy the index into worktrees
copyIntoWorktrees.description: When a git worktree has no CodeGraph index, copy one from the main working tree (or another worktree) and sync it to the worktree's branch.

autoInit.title: Index repositories that have none
autoInit.description: Run `codegraph init` in the background when the session's git repository has no index and none can be copied.
